about: List prices, pay-as-you-go, from each vendor's own pricing page. Every numeric price has a `sources` entry (url, the quoted text, date_accessed). No free tier is applied by the cost model unless asked (a free tier is per account, a per-person cost at scale is not). bench/cost/model.test.mjs fails if a price has no source.

r2.name: Cloudflare R2 (Standard)
r2.notes: Deletes are free. Egress is free.

min_monthly_usd.quote: no minimum is stated on the pricing page

s3.name: AWS S3 Standard (us-east-1)
s3.notes: Internet egress is billed per GB after the account's first 100 GB a month, but the per-GB rate was not readable from the fetched page text, so it is left null and the model reports S3 as a lower bound. The us-east-1 request and storage rates were confirmed through AWS documentation and blog text; the price-list JSON read directly was us-west-2 (identical figures).

storage_per_gb_month.quote: S3 Standard "Standard Storage First 50 TB per GB Mo" price 0.0230000000 (us-west-2 in https://b0.p.awsstatic.com/pricing/2.0/meteredUnitMaps/s3/USD/current/s3.json; us-east-1 $0.023 per AWS docs)

class_a_per_million.quote: "PUT COPY/POST or LIST requests per Requests" 0.0000050000 = $0.005 per 1,000

class_b_per_million.quote: "GET and all other requests per Requests" 0.0000004000 = $0.0004 per 1,000

egress_per_gb.quote: not quoted: only "Data transferred out to the internet for the first 100GB per month" is free was readable

min_monthly_usd.quote: no minimum charge on S3 Standard

gcs.name: Google Cloud Storage Standard (single region)
gcs.notes: Egress rate not readable from the fetched pages (tiered by destination), so null and GCS is reported as a lower bound. Storage and operation rates are from Google's pricing and pricing-examples pages as returned by search; the pricing page body itself did not render in the fetch tool.

storage_per_gb_month.quote: "Standard storage in a single region" $0.020 per GB per month (pricing examples, us-east1)

class_a_per_million.quote: Standard Class A operations $0.005 per 1,000 (flat namespace)

egress_per_gb.quote: not readable in the fetched page text

min_monthly_usd.quote: no minimum charge on Standard storage

b2.name: Backblaze B2
b2.notes: $6.95 per TB per month (decimal TB: $0.00695 per GB). Egress is free up to 3x the average stored data, $0.01 per GB beyond. Class A, B and C calls are free; no minimum storage duration.

class_a_per_million.quote: "Class A, B, and C API calls are free"

class_b_per_million.quote: "Class A, B, and C API calls are free"

egress_per_gb.quote: free egress "up to 3x" average monthly stored data; overage "$0.01/GB"

egress_free_multiple_of_stored.quote: free egress "up to 3x" average monthly stored data

min_monthly_usd.quote: "No minimum file size fees" and "No minimum storage duration fees"

wasabi.name: Wasabi (Pay as You Go)
wasabi.notes: $7.99 per TB per month. The minimum monthly charge is tied to 1 TB of active storage per account (so $7.99 a month whatever is stored), and a deleted object is billed for 90 days. Both hurt a history store that deletes often.
